source_clause_hashes.text: Design, launch and oversee a multi-agent crew in any agent harness (Claude Code, Kiro, Codex, Gemini CLI, or any harness that can start sub-agents and read and write files) that runs a long job to a defined goal against acceptance criteria fixed up front: a lead, workers, fresh verifiers, a safety watch and an independent drift auditor, with change control. Use when the user types /engos-orchestration-crew (with or without a command such as help, design, launch, status, end) or wants a long, checkable, multi-agent job (an A/B evaluation, QA of a built system, an audit or a migration) run unattended with no drift. Do not use for short or single-agent tasks.
Fulfill the source contract retained under Imported operating instructions. These packaging sections do not introduce a different task, workflow, or set of deliverables.
